title: Every Trump Threat to Abandon NATO Hollows It Out
partialText: Doubts that the United States would come to the aid of NATO allies increase each time, prompting Europeans to consider an alliance without Washington.

title: 5 Takeaways From Trump’s Speech on Iran
partialText: President Trump did not define a clear path out of the conflict, which he estimated would end within three weeks.

title: U.K. to Host Talks on Securing Strait of Hormuz
partialText: It was not clear whether the talks, expected to involve dozens of countries, would satisfy President Trump’s demand that other nations take a more active part in the Iran war.

title: Trump Has Discussed Firing Attorney General Pam Bondi
partialText: President Trump has not made a final decision, but he has floated the idea of replacing Ms. Bondi with Lee Zeldin, the E.P.A. administrator.

title: Trump Faces a Tough Fight With His New Budget
partialText: Last year, the president proposed many steep spending cuts that Congress never granted. This time, he may face an even tougher sell.

title: China’s Aiming for the Moon, and NASA Is Looking Over Its Shoulder
partialText: The U.S. space agency launched a lunar flyby Wednesday, but Beijing is pursuing its own space program with formidable focus. Here’s what we know about it, in photos and videos.

title: Artemis II Completes First Day of Its NASA Lunar Mission
partialText: The crew, three Americans and a Canadian, are the first humans to travel to the moon in more than 50 years. They will not land on the surface, but the mission will pave the way for future visits.

title: ActBlue May Have Misled Congress on Vetting Foreign Donations, Its Lawyers Warned
partialText: The Democratic fund-raising group is facing investigations from the Justice Department and congressional Republicans ahead of the midterm elections.

title: Tina Peters, Colorado Election Denier, Has Prison Sentence Overturned
partialText: Ms. Peters, a former county clerk, received a nine-year sentence after being convicted of tampering with voting machines. An appeals court overturned the sentence but did not immediately free her from prison.

title: Why Everyone Loves ‘Love on the Spectrum’
partialText: Without exploitation, “Love on the Spectrum” captures the triumphs and travails of dating. It has become one of Netflix’s most popular shows.

title: What Drives Patrick Radden Keefe?
partialText: Patrick Radden Keefe’s carefully applied ambition has propelled him to a rarefied perch.

title: Investigators Said to Look at Whether LaGuardia Controller Stepped Away
partialText: Officials are said to be examining whether a controller had to use an emergency phone just before the crash at LaGuardia. They have yet to determine the cause of the crash and are also focusing on other avenues.

title: Nutrition Will Now Be Required in Medical Schools After RFK Jr. Pressure
partialText: As Robert F. Kennedy Jr. calls for medical schools to redesign curriculums, an agency that oversees dozens has deleted diversity standards and added nutrition.

title: Why People With Chronic Illness Are Turning to AI Chatbots for Health Advice
partialText: Some women with complex chronic illnesses are using chatbots to search for diagnoses or relief from their symptoms.

title: How A.I. Helped One Man (and His Brother) Build a $1.8 Billion Company
partialText: Who needs more than two employees when artificial intelligence can do so many corporate tasks? It’s super efficient — and a little bit lonely.

title: After Sting Operation, Cousin of Bashar al-Assad Convicted in Arms for Drugs Deal
partialText: The cousin, Antoine Kassis, was found guilty of conspiracy to support a terrorist group, after trying to sell weapons from the fallen regime to a Colombian militia.

title: Kanye West Plays First American Concert Since 2021
partialText: After years of antisemitic behavior, the rapper formerly known as Kanye West performed his first full live show in the United States since 2021.

title: Meet the ‘Literary King of Tulsa’ (Before He Moves to Seattle)
partialText: In his free time, Jeff Martin mobilized best-selling authors to travel to sold-out events in his hometown. He will soon expand his horizons.

title: Every President Tries It. It Never Works.
partialText: What’s really behind all these attempts to revive American industry?

title: To Keep Child Abuse Off the Internet, He Has to Watch It
partialText: Removing child sexual abuse material from the internet exacts a heavy toll on the workers tasked with reviewing it.

title: Primetime Trump
partialText: We have takeaways from the president’s address to the nation.

title: New York Is a Hot Spot for Alpha-Gal. Why Doesn’t the State Track Cases?
partialText: In more than 10 states, laboratories or doctors must notify the state health authorities of each positive test for a marker of the syndrome.

title: Europe Pushes for a Gentler Internet for Children
partialText: The European Union and national capitals are trying to make social media and algorithms less addictive and safer, especially for children.

title: Ancient Artifacts Stolen in Dutch Museum Heist Are Recovered
partialText: The golden helmet of Cotofenesti, a highly regarded artifact from Romania, and two elaborate golden bracelets were taken in January 2025.

title: Volunteers in Helicopter Rescue Hiker’s Dog After a Week in the Wilderness
partialText: A hiker in New Zealand fell 180 feet down a waterfall and was evacuated without her dog. A crowd-funded rescue effort reunited them.
